entries.name: Jobicy

verification.method: Read the provider's public API documentation and terms (HTTP GET) and one sample response.
verification.evidence: API documented at https://jobicy.com/jobs-rss-feed: GET /api/v2/remote-jobs, 'No token or account is required for the public Jobs API.'

entries.terms: Fair use (jobicy.com/jobs-rss-feed): reuse allowed without individual permission; keep Jobicy as the source and preserve the canonical Jobicy job URL; no more than one automated pass per hour; handle HTTP 429 with deferred retry.
entries.limitations: Remote jobs published in the last 7 days only. Free tier links to Jobicy pages, not the employer's ATS. An aggregator: never evidence of Kenya eligibility on its own.

entries.name: Arbeitnow

verification.method: Read the provider's public API documentation and terms (HTTP GET) and one sample response.
verification.evidence: API documented at https://www.arbeitnow.com/blog/job-board-api: GET /api/job-board-api, 'requires no API key'. Listing URLs in the API's own responses use www.arbeitnow.com, .co.uk, .fr, .ch and .nl (page 1 sampled 2026-10-17).

entries.terms: Free public API: 'please do not abuse. I would appreciate linking back to the site' (meta.terms); use is subject to Arbeitnow's terms of service.
entries.limitations: Mostly Germany and Netherlands jobs, some remote. Incremental: reads newest pages only. An aggregator: never evidence of Kenya eligibility on its own.

entries.name: Remote OK

verification.method: Read the provider's public API documentation and terms (HTTP GET) and one sample response.
verification.evidence: Public JSON API at https://remoteok.com/api; legal terms at https://remoteok.com/legal (updated July 20, 2026).

entries.terms: Link back to the Remote OK URL (followed link) and mention Remote OK as the source; do not use the Remote OK logo.
entries.limitations: A single recent window of remote jobs. Apply links are Remote OK pages. An aggregator: never evidence of Kenya eligibility on its own.
